01 · The Enunciate

The project: what was asked in a banking agent brain

Build routing brain from a digital bank service agent. Before any expensive LLM call, the system decides the cheapest and safest way to answer each message.

The three pillars of architecture

Pillar Engineering Problem Code Component
1 · Router Sort Query in FAST_PATH (Cheers/FAQ) or AGENT (needs tool + reasoning). candidate_starter/router.py
2 · Retrieval Tool Select 2 more relevant tools between 285 before mounting the LLM prompt. candidate_starter/retrieval.py
3 · Evaluation Harness Measure quality, cost, latency and security in a deterministic way offline. candidate_starter/harness.py

The non-negotiable restriction of the domain

"This is a banking domain. An incorrect tool is not an acceptable approach. Never execute a tool if the decision is below safety thresholds. Never remove quality gates just to increase recall or economy. Do not use expected_tool the dataset within the production logic. This field can only be used by the harness to evaluate offline."

The Border: production does not see the template

What separates adjustment engineering from template is one line: expected_tool lives in evaluation layer and never in production logic.

Production logic router · retrieval · taxonomy

Decide with signs available at the time of application: confidence of the router, score of the retriever, relative margin and the verb of the query. Nothing more.

Assessment layer harness.py

expected_tool Do eval_dataset.json only read Here.offline to score Hit Rate after the decision has already been made.

Border Proof static lexical verification 
grep -n "expected_tool" candidate_starter/retrieval.py candidate_starter/router.py candidate_starter/taxonomy.py
# Saída: zero resultados.

02 · The Measure Failure

Silent Crash: the failure that 54 tests did not catch

In an intermediate iteration (commit c8f30d2), the project showed: 54 tests on green, 100% router, 100% Hit Rate@2, zero incorrect executions and status approved with praise. An external review, however, requested a collision test between reading and writing vocabulary.

Customer Query: "What's the email registered to my account?" — a READING.

Before — 3 guards Execute writing
✕ Top-1 · atualizar_email — WRITER 0.4795
· Top-2 · confirmar_email_cadastrado 0.2554

Margin (0.4795 − 0.2554) / 0.4795 = 0.467 >> 0.25 → the margin guard it won't catch. High trust, high score, loose margin: IMPLEMENTATION — The officer alters the record of those who only asked.

Then — steering guard (G4) Run read
✓ Top-1 · consultar_email_vinculado_conta — READING 0.3891
✕ atualizar_email — WRITTEN, DISAPPEARED —

The Query is for reading; the writing ability is discarded before the ranking. Margin (0.3891 − 0.1792) / 0.3891 = 0.539 > 0.25 → runs the consultation, dry cut, no transition.

None of the three old guards took it: the mistake It's not a tie. — is a decision confident and wrong. This illustrates the central thesis of the pillar Trust Engineering: the most dangerous error in AI does not generate code exception. He passes the green and makes a ruinous decision with loose margins.

03 · Structural Diagnosis

Why no vectorization weight solves the problem

When the problem appeared, the first attempt was to adjust the combination of weights between lexical search and intent search (score = (1−α)·lexical + α·intent). The mathematical demonstration below proves why this is impossible:

Arithmetic Analysis Writing Query vs Reading Tool 
Query: "Quero mudar o e-mail vinculado a minha conta" (ESCRITA)

consultar_email_vinculado_conta  -> lexical = 0.8457 | intent = 0.4400
atualizar_email                  -> lexical = 0.1983 | intent = 0.3200

Para a escrita vencer por ajuste de α:
(1 - α)·0.1983 + α·0.3200 > (1 - α)·0.8457 + α·0.4400
α·(0.3200 - 0.4400 - 0.1983 + 0.8457) > 0.8457 - 0.1983
0.5274·α > 0.6474  =>  α > 1.227 (IMPOSSÍVEL, pois α ∈ [0, 1])

The structural lesson: Reading and writing on the same object share all nouns (e-mail, conta, cadastro). The difference between consultation and change is one word: the verb. In a bag of words with TF-IDF, this verb is diluted between ten tokens. The direction of the operation is not recoverable by textual similarity — it needs to be a semantic restriction declared.

04 · The Rigid Solution

The 4 Layers Pre-Execution Barrier

Four deterministic guards chained up. The Query only advances to the LLM and to the execution of tools if it passes through all four locks. If any guard fails, the system diverts to abstinence or human care.

G1

Route Trust

Calibrated Router < 0.75 trust? If you fail, the retriever is not invoked.

HUMAN_FALLBACK_LOW_CONFIDENCE
G2

Minimum Candidate Score

No retriever candidate reaches the minimum lexical/intent score of 0.10?

ABSTAIN_LOW_SCORE
G3

Relative Margin between Candidates

Margin (s₁ − s₂)/s₁ < 0.25? ? Top-1 and top-2 are too close (technical tie).

AMBIGUOUS_CONFIRMATION
G4

Steering Guard (Read vs Writing)

Direction extracted from the Query verb is different from the direction (mode: read|write) declared in the tool?

Discard (Read→Writing) or Debasement

The deliberate asymmetry of Guard 4

  • WRITTEN READ CHERY + WRITTEN Tool: Total disposal of tool. Changing the record of those who just asked is irreversible damage to the customer.
  • Written Query + READING Tool: Score down, don't rule it out. Refer to those who requested change is unfulfilled task — recoverable in the following message.

05 · Pipeline

The Final Architecture in 4 Layers

the full flow of the application until the implementation authorisation:

1 · Router calibration router.py

TfidfVectorizer(ngram_range=(1,2)) + LogisticRegression calibrated via CalibratedClassifierCV(method="sigmoid") Platt scaling. Solves the problem of underconfidence by regularization L2 in small dataset without artificially inflating probabilities.

2 · Taxonomy & Governance taxonomy.py

Declaration of 14 canonical capabilities and 45 variants with operation mode (read or write). Map the user vocabulary (aliases) for intentions and solve semantic duplicates of the catalog.

3 · Multi-field Retriever retrieval.py

BM25F score combination: score = 0.5·lexical + 0.5·intent. The alias glossary is indexed in a separate field to prevent L2 normalization from diluting the original terms. It performs capacity collapse by returning different canonical top-k.

4 · Barrier & Harness harness.py

Quality Gate tri-state (APROVADO, REPROVADO, INDETERMINADO). Validate the four guards before the execution mock. If there is no transactional query in the benchmark, the result is marked as UNDETERMINED by security.

06 · Catalog Governance

The catalog is the problem, not the vectorization

The initial diagnosis of low recall (35% Hit Rate@2) seemed a failure of the model. The tool register examination revealed the real cause: semantic duplications accumulated by different teams over years.

Example of Duplication in the Register 4 of the 8 tools to "get invoice" 
consultar_fatura                  -> "Gera o PDF ou linha digitável da fatura do mês atual."
gerar_linha_digitavel_fatura      -> "Gera a linha digitável da fatura ... para pagamentos."
enviar_pdf_fatura_atual           -> "Envia o PDF da fatura atual ... para o cliente."
consultar_valor_fatura_mes_atual  -> "Consulta o valor da fatura ... do mês atual."

For a simple lexical retriever, the hyperspecific variant always wins the canonical because it repeats word for word of the query. The solution was to introduce the concept of Canon Capacity with Collapse: the retriever groups the variants under the same capacity and returns in k=2 two capacities different. The specific variant that married is preserved in matched_variant as an audit trail for runtime.

07 · Measured Evolution

Economy without success rate is disguised risk

As Goodhart's Law ("when a metric becomes a goal, it ceases to be a good metric"), blindly optimizing cost savings led the initial pipeline to abstain from almost half of calls, artificially inflating the percentage of savings.

Metric / Iteration Initial commit (fc830dc) Crash Iteration (c8f30d2) Published version (1f780c0)
Automated Tests 35 54 72 passed, 0 skipped
Hit Rate@2 35% 100% 100%
Correct Top-1 Execution 20% (4/20) 95% (19/20) 100% (20/20)
Incorrect Executions 7 incorrect 0 (but vulnerable) 0 incorrect
Reading Solving Writing Not measured Yes (margin 0.47) Impossible (G4)
Fallback for Low Trust 9 abstentions 0 0
Economy of LLM measured (benchmark) 87.8% (inflated) 78,9% 77.8% (real net)
Harness Status REPROVED APPROVED APPROVED IN BENCHMARK

Why did the economy fall from 87.8% to 77.8%? In the first version, 9 improper abstentions avoided LLM calls, inflating the economy while delivering only 20% success. The final version solves 20 out of 20 transactional issues with 100% hit and paid LLM for all of them.

What 77.8% measures — and what does not measure. It is the reduction of cost of LLM calls between the smart pipeline and the "everything for LLM" baseline on the offline benchmark. It's not a financial economy Total system: the cost of human fallback, for example, is premise and not measurement — so report public cost_savings_pct_on_resolved, deferred_to_human and human_fallback_breakeven_cost_usd side by side.

08 · Procedure

How was developed: the agentic method with embedded criticism

Development didn't follow a straight line. Two rounds were driven by external adverse review, where each note generated a diagnostic cycle, ADR measurement (Architecture Decision Record) and extended testing suite. The third had no reviewer: appeared because the steady state has been tested instead of green.

Round 1

Commit Review fc830dc

35% recall diagnosis, 7 incorrect executions and inflated economy. It produced ADRs 0006 and 0007, raising the suite from 35 to 54 tests.

Round 2

Adverse Review of the Committee c8f30d2

Mapping of 8 remaining risks. The recommended reading/writing collision test exposed the Silent Crash. It generated ADR-008 and added the collision tests to the suite.

Round 3

The saga of the origin of the report — commits 0d2c9ae … 1f780c0

Regenerate candidate_report.json And running the suite again revealed the count with a 1 skipped Too much. O skip was not benign conditional — it was a silent test giving up. Corrected, the suite closes in 72 passed, 0 skipped.

The origin that contaminated the measurement itself

The metric report is versioned — and a versioned JSON ages silently: the code changes, the file stays, and those who read believe in numbers that the current commit no longer produces. The project has a test that rewards decisions against the current code. This test had three defects of the same family, all with the report soiling the measurement that should audit it:

  1. Unsatisfactory assertion. Requirement snapshot.git_commit == HEAD. How to commit the report creates a new commit, snapshot always points to the previous one — the assertion could never pass. The real auditable property is another: between the commit which generated the report and the HEAD, nothing outside of reports/ changed — and the failure becomes name files Late.
  2. git_dirty self-sucking. build_snapshot() counted reports/ on the dirty tree check. As the report is written by the function itself, from the second execution onward it was declared irreproductive because of the file that it had just generated.
  3. _git().strip() ate the status prefix space. The filter sliced line[3:] Do --porcelain, but .strip() at the exit removes the initial space from the first line: the path exited displaced (eports/...), the filter never married and the test He would jump again in silence. Solved by delegating the filter to git itself (pathspec ':(exclude)reports'), without parsing.

A green suite with 1 skipped He looked healthy. It wasn't — the skip It was a test giving up silently, and it only appeared because the stationary state was tested (regenerate the report, rotate the suite again) instead of accepting the green. It is the third instance of the thesis of this page: Green metrics are not coverage.

Principles governing decisions

  • Measure before editing: No changes were made without registering the metric table before/after ADR.
  • Never move the beam: Easy solutions (such as climbing probability parameters to mask errors) were summarily rejected.
  • No Effect Tests: Tests that ensure that mock_tool_execution is never called If any guard fails.
  • Test steady state: It is not enough for the suite to pass once — it must continue passing after the system writes its own artifacts.

09 · Executable Specification

The Suite of 72 Tests as System Specification

Eight test files divided by security and integrity invariants. The part more valuable does not check a returned value; check that Nothing happened.:

test_taxonomy.py The most expensive security invariant in the domain, verified in the full ranking 
def test_a_read_request_can_never_resolve_to_a_write_capability(retriever):
    """Antes da guarda de direcao, "Qual e o email cadastrado na minha conta?"
    devolvia atualizar_email (ESCRITA) em 1o lugar com margem relativa de 0.47 —
    acima do limiar de 0.25: a guarda de margem NAO pegava."""
    for query in read_requests:            # 5 consultas puras
        for m in retriever.search(query, k=3).matches:
            assert CAPABILITY_MODE.get(m.name) != "write"

Test Suite Categories

  • No effect: mock_tool_execution is never called when any guard fails (executed.assert_not_called()).
  • Taxonomy Integrity: 7 authorship invariants (existence in the catalogue, absence of collision, reading, writing, declared and inherited direction).
  • Generalization without Adjustment to Gabarite: 12 paraphrases written with totally absent vocabulary from the official dataset (9/12 on top-1, 11/12 on top-2).
  • Stability and Origin: Shuffle the order in the catalogue does not change any decision; the JSON report corresponds exactly to the commit and current code — and this check Can't jump (it was the fault of round 3).

10 · Technical Transparency

Real Project Limitations (What Benchmark Does Not Cover)

Publishing limitations is what separates advertising engineering. The 7 restrictions below are registered in the README of the official repository:

  1. Approved in this benchmark, not for live banking production: 30 queries, 53 training examples and molded tools. Real traffic with opponents requires layers of MFA, authorization and idempotence outside this scope.
  2. The steering guard only protects what is stated: 59 of the 285 tools have mode (14 canonical capacities + 45 variants). The others 226 They pass without driving restrictions. The right architectural place for mode is the register itself — is metadatad from the endpoint, not taxonomy.
  3. Paraphrased lexical recovery ceiling: The recall of pure paraphrases without keywords reaches 9/12 in the top-1. The next step requires dense/reranker embeddings.
  4. Manually maintained taxonomy: 14 capabilities and 45 variants configured in Python code over 285 tools.
  5. Guards 2 and 3 are no longer exercised by the official benchmark: With 20/20 and zero abstentions, they are proven only by tests of no effect. A benchmark that never triggers the security network doesn't show it works.
  6. Router calibration break is narrow: A Query AGENT less confident registers 0.7674 against the threshold of 0.75 — 0.017 Off duty, registered as a liability. (On the other hand the margins of the right decisions lie between 0.592 and 0.741 against the threshold of 0.25: this, yes, loose.)
  7. Human fallback cost is premise, not measurement: The reliable number is the equilibrium point, which is derived from measurements.

In short

What is the Case Agents project

O case-agents is the implementation and benchmark of a routing brain for banking agent: decides if a query needs LLM, selects 2 tools between 285 registered and blocks execution when the decision is not reliable enough.

  • The ability is to choose the right tool; trust is to know when not to execute any.
  • Catalog governance — collapse of semantic duplicates in 14 canonical capabilities raised Hit Rate@2 from 35% to 100%.
  • The Silent Crash contained — the Board of Directors (reading vs writing) prevented an e-mail consultation from changing the client's record.
  • Real cost savings — 77.8% of economy with 100% success in executions.

Case study Trust Engineering and AI Agent Engineering.

Frequently Asked Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the Case Agents project?

It is the development and evaluation of the brain routing and selection of tools of a digital banking service agent. It classifies the message in FAST PATH or AGENT, retrieves the 2 most relevant tools between 285 and applies a 4-layer pre-execution barrier before calling any LLM.

What is Silent Crash measured in the project?

A failure in which a query query ("What is the email registered in my account?") resolved with high confidence and loose margin (0.47) for the registration change tool (update email). The failure went through 54 tests and 3 traditional guards without generating exception.

How does the steering guard work?

The Direction Guard (G4) analyzes the query verb and compares it to the mode of operation (read/write) stated in the tool. If the query is read and the tool is written, the system completely discards the tool to prevent irreversible damage to the client's registration.

How to achieve 100% success with cost savings?

Declaring the governance of the tool catalog (collapse of semantic duplicates in canonical capabilities) and applying the 4-layer pre-execution barrier (router confidence, minimum score, relative margin and direction). Net cost savings were 77.8%.
